user.title: Connect Testo Smart Connect
user.description: Enter your Smart Connect API add-on key and select the region of your account. [Open Testo Cloud]({cloud_url}). Validation retrieves device information; the initial synchronization may take a few minutes.

error.invalid_auth: The API key is invalid or expired.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to retrieve Testo data. Check region, API permissions and quota.
error.no_devices: No devices or account identity were returned.

abort.wrong_account: Use a key belonging to the same Testo account and region.
